## Activity

This report summarises activity at River Outreach during December 2023. The clinic team completed 58 captures during the reporting period. The capture total provides the overall measure of activity for the site and forms the basis for the image quality and grading results reported below. No further activity measure is included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 58 captures, 7 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 12.1 per cent. The ungradable findings should be considered when reviewing the overall capture output for River Outreach. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the usual process.

## Grading

There were 8 referable results from the reporting period. The median grading lag was 0. Together, these figures provide the reported grading outcome for December 2023. The results should be reviewed alongside the capture total and image-quality findings to support routine site monitoring.
